{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Apparently this part of space is known for causing hallucinations.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
A '''hallucination''' was an event where an individual believed to see an object or objects that did not truly exist. The [[rhak-skuri]] creature caused hallucinations on [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] victims and fed on their resulting terror.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

The [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] was known to produce hallucinations of [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] and other [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]] in both Force-sensitive and non&ndash;Force-sensitive individuals that were traveling in the vicinity.<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref><ref name="Omen" />
